title: svgif component preset
description: One component preset. component and motionPreset are the registry documents by $ref. parameters holds default values. motionPreset may be omitted. The registry has no maximum count. category is an open slug. later and out are not categories. adr:svgif/20261110181452.

id.description: Stable lowercase kebab slug, unique across the registry.

category.description: Directory name under presets/. A v1 type id is an addressable category. The set is open. later and out are not categories.

parameters.description: Default parameter values. No maximum count. A non-reserved parameter may carry bind. values is the declared set a swap must cover.

values.description: Declared values for an enumeration. A swap is honest only when its variants cover exactly this set, including the default. A continuous number does not declare a made-up set.

bind.description: One transform applied to the named layers. replace sets property to the parameter value. scale multiplies a numeric property by the value, or scales a path about origin. inverse-scale multiplies by at divided by the value, so a larger value shrinks. offset adds a number, or moves a path by both components of a point. A one-axis path offset moves along axis. projected-offset moves a path opposite a camera shift by the gain from the compiler camera. reproject replaces the baked faces with the compiler camera at the new latitude or azimuth. swap writes the keys stored for that value, and one value may store a different key list per layer. repeat sets the element count and steps copies along axis by the element size plus gap. retime multiplies key frames, or the timeline duration when property is duration. Optional at is the value that leaves the property unchanged. Scale and retime default at to 1. A numeric offset defaults at to 0. A point offset names at as that point. inverse-scale, projected-offset, and reproject require at.

layers.description: Layer ids or timeline node ids. A name that matches neither is a broken bind.

at.description: Parameter value that leaves the named property unchanged. A number for scale, retime, or a numeric offset. A point for a 2D offset: [x, y] or a string of two numbers such as 160 90. Scale and retime default this to 1. A numeric offset defaults this to 0.

origin.description: Scale origin for a path. A point [x, y], or center. Omitted and center use the center of the path bounding box at key 0.

axis.description: Direction for a numeric path offset, or the repeat direction. x, y, or a unit vector [dx, dy]. Repeat accepts x or y and defaults to x. A numeric path offset requires this. A point offset names at instead.

gap.description: Extra space in px between repeated copies. Defaults to 0. Copies sit at the element width or height plus this gap.

layer.description: Layer id this key list writes. Omitted, the keys write onto every named layer. The same value may name one key list per layer.

keys.description: Key list written onto the named property. Same fields as a motion-preset key.
